newsitem.title: USA: NYNJ port authority approve JFK 1,400 space garage.
newsitem.headline: NYNJ port authority approve JFK 1,400 space garage.

text.p: NEW YORK, FEB 11 - (Reuter) The Board of Commissioners at The Port Authority of New York and New Jersey authorized a $46 million project to build a 1,400-space, helical ramp parking garage at JFK to be built in the southwest area of the airport's ring of passenger terminals.
"This project will ensure an adequate supply of parking for Kennedy's customers," said Lewis Eisenberg, chairman of The Port Authority.

New construction projects at JFK, coupled with projected growth in the number of passengers will result in a need for additional parking facilities, the chairman said. The new garage is expected to be completed in 1998. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+ 5017
